Polugaevsky died of a brain tumour in 1995.

a.text: He was awarded the title of International Grandmaster by FIDE.

b.text: Polugaevsky won at Mar del Plata in 1962.

a.text: Sicilian Love – Lev Polugaevsky Chess Tournament 1994 (Buenos Aires) was published, with Jeroen Piket and the New in Chess Editorial team.

b.text: A Sicilian Defence-themed tournament was held in Buenos Aires in October 1994.

a.text: Polugaevsky played this game from the 1969 Soviet championship against Tal.

b.text: Polugaevsky worked with Boris Spassky as the latter was preparing for his successful 1969 world championship match with Tigran Petrosian.
